versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Small units that borrow another unit's text and tribe, from the shop, your board, sold units or the enemy.
They also swap units with the shop, and pay off for keeping or changing what they wear.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Coat-Peg Steward now moves stats instead of copying them, closing a buy-back loop that doubled a unit each Exchange.
Wording fixes: borrowed When played and Start of Combat fire at once, the Keeper doesn't stack, the Lady's Guises don't count as taking or keeping, Exchange names its token.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
The Fetch now copies your carry's stats, text and Guises, and Tam's text can't be worn, fixing two rules clashes.
A Guise taken when played counts as kept that turn, and the Placement Officer moves a Guise onto the unit it brings in.
